body: [14.5.6](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/5.0/en/0x22-V14-Config.md#14.5) mentions the conflicting Transfer-encoding and Content-Length headers. The wording is still open to interpretation while if we would say that RFC 2616 (in which is says: "If a message is received with both a Transfer-Encoding header field and a Content-Length header field, the latter MUST be ignored.") should be followed correctly, we more specific.
title: V14.5.6 Refer to RFC
